high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "wintourworld." The post was taken on March 11, 2022, in London, England. The photo features a person wearing a distinctive outfit that includes a long coat with a bold pattern of horse heads in a geometric design. The coat is predominantly blue with beige and black accents, and it has studded details along the edges. The person is also wearing large, dark sunglasses and a necklace with multiple pendants.
